# New-ZbxHostPrototype

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a host prototype.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxHostPrototype [[-Name] <string>] [-RuleId <ulong>] [-Uuid <string>] [-DisplayName <string>] [-CustomInterfaces <ZabbixHostPrototypeInterfaceMode>] [-Status <ZabbixHostStatus>] [-Discover <ZabbixDiscoverMode>] [-Interface <ZabbixHostPrototypeInterfaceRequest[]>] [-GroupLink <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]>] [-GroupPrototype <ZabbixHostPrototypeGroupPrototypeRequest[]>] [-Template <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-Tag <ZabbixTagRequest[]>] [-Macro <ZabbixHostPrototypeMacroRequest[]>] [-InventoryMode <ZabbixHostInventoryMode>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A host prototype is the pattern a discovery rule turns into one host per entity it finds, such as a virtual machine of a hypervisor. The New-ZbxHostPrototype cmdlet sends hostprototype.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new host prototype back with hostprototype.get and writes it. The server requires -RuleId, -Name and -GroupLink; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a host prototype

```powershell
$rule = Get-ZbxDiscoveryRule -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Virtual machines'
New-ZbxHostPrototype -Name '{#VM.NAME}' -RuleId $rule.ItemId -GroupLink 'Linux servers'
```

Creates a host prototype named {#VM.NAME}. The command writes the new host prototype, read back from the server.

## INPUTS

- `ulong`: Bound to -RuleId (ByPropertyName).
- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName), -DisplayName (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixHostPrototypeInterfaceMode`: Bound to -CustomInterfaces (ByPropertyName). The host prototype interface mode values: HOST_PROT_INTERFACES_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixHostStatus`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The host status values: HOST_STATUS_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixDiscoverMode`: Bound to -Discover (ByPropertyName). The discover mode values: ZBX_PROTOTYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixHostPrototypeInterfaceRequest[]`: Bound to -Interface (ByPropertyName). interfaces of a ZabbixHostPrototypeCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]`: Bound to -GroupLink (ByPropertyName). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ZabbixHostPrototypeGroupPrototypeRequest[]`: Bound to -GroupPrototype (ByPropertyName). groupPrototypes of a ZabbixHostPrototypeCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]`: Bound to -Template (ByPropertyName). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ZabbixTagRequest[]`: Bound to -Tag (ByPropertyName). A tag to set on an object: a name with an optional value, such as env=prod.
- `ZabbixHostPrototypeMacroRequest[]`: Bound to -Macro (ByPropertyName). macros of a ZabbixHostPrototypeCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixHostInventoryMode`: Bound to -InventoryMode (ByPropertyName). The host inventory mode values: HOST_INVENTORY_* in defines.inc.php.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
